newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece to auction 100 bln drachs of 7-yr FRNs.
newsitem.headline: Greece to auction 100 bln drachs of 7-yr FRNs.

text.p: Greece will auction 100 billion drachmas of seven-year floaters on August 21 with the first annual coupon set at 10.30 percent, the finance ministry said in a statement.
Annual coupons on FRNs are set according to the ongoing 12-month T-bill rate, currently at 9.50 percent, plus a spread -- now standing at 80 basis points.
The finance ministry also invited non-competitive bids and said it would satisfy them up to 20 percent of the amount of competitive bids. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
